question: Can the winter-hero sweep score WebGPU canvas pixels in the browser without per-candidate PNG/CDP round trips while preserving the screenshot metric?
hypothesis: A reused browser-side canvas and cached reference pixels will return the same hero gap within 1e-6 and reduce hot capture time across the 24-candidate sweep.

conditions.baseline: Page.captureScreenshot + base64 transfer + PNG decode + two new canvases per candidate

acceptance.parity: first candidate direct-canvas and screenshot hero gaps differ by at most 1e-6; otherwise use screenshot for the whole batch
acceptance.quality: Stanford-ORB held-out and fixed winter hero remain within their existing limits
acceptance.speed: record meanHotCaptureMilliseconds, metricPath, metricParityDelta and per-candidate metricMilliseconds
